# Tabler Icons (outline) — vendored

Source: https://github.com/tabler/tabler-icons · @tabler/icons 3.48.0 · MIT licence (see LICENSE; no attribution needed in videos).

- outline.json — name → SVG nodes (24×24, stroke 2, round caps). Only icons a spec uses are inlined into frames.
- index.json — name → category + tags, for `studio icons <query>`.
